sections.Profile:
"This is Spinal Tap" pinball machine by Homepin, released in 2022, is based on the cult-classic rockumentary of the same name. It features a 27-inch LCD backglass that plays clips from the film, along with a traditional DMD for score displays.

- Manufacturer: Homepin
- Years made: 2022
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 4
- Tags: 2020s, Licensed, Solid State
